# apipbx_moh_class (Resource)

A music on hold class: recordings played in order (or shuffled). A queue plays it by naming it in music_on_hold. Import with "<tenant id>/<id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Letters, digits, _ and -; a queue's music_on_hold names it.
- `recordings` (List of String) Recording ids, played in this order.
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Optional

- `random` (Boolean) Play the recordings in random order.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
